card.name: During before historical eras
card.fires_on: The word "during" (or a nearby linking word) right before a named historical period, such as a war, dynasty or era. It follows a person or event, as in "an official during the 20th Dynasty".

modes.label: During + era
modes.description: The word "during" after a person or event, just before a war, dynasty or historical age.
modes.example: Herihor was an official<< during>> the 20th Dynasty and usur

modes.label: Other words before an era
modes.description: Other words that lead into a historical period, such as "of", a place name or "lived".

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "during" and its translations, and away from words for ancient times or old eras.
card.plain: It fires on "during" when the text is about to name a past war or historical era.
